run_multiclass_retrieval_evaluation: run the evaluate function to compute multiclass image and text retrieval recall metrics for a CLIP model
test_evaluate_function: test the evaluate function with a CLIP-like model, dataloader, tokenizer, and retrieval template
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that computes image and text retrieval recall@1 across multiple classes
refactor_evaluate_amp: refactor the evaluate function to support configurable automatic mixed precision for model encoding
summarize_evaluate_metrics: summarize the evaluate function that returns per-class and multiclass average retrieval recall metrics
